title: Past perfect - Introduction to past perfect

options.answer: She has finished her work before I came.
She had finished her work before I came.
She have finished her work before I came.

explanation.en: Past perfect (had + past participle) is used for actions completed before another past action. 'Had finished' shows completion before 'came'.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее совершенное время (had + причастие прошедшего времени) используется для действий, завершенных до другого прошедшего действия.
explanation.uz: Past perfect (had + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi) boshqa o'tgan zamon harakatidan oldin tugallangan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

options.answer: They had already left when we arrived.
They have already left when we arrived.
They already left when we arrived.

explanation.en: Past perfect 'had left' is correct because the leaving happened before the arriving (both past actions).
explanation.ru: Прошедшее совершенное время 'had left' правильно, потому что уход произошел до прибытия (оба прошедшие действия).
explanation.uz: 'Had left' to'g'ri, chunki ketish yetib kelishdan oldin sodir bo'lgan (ikkala harakat ham o'tmishda).

options.answer: I had never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
I had never saw such a beautiful sunset before.
I never had seen such a beautiful sunset before.

explanation.en: Past perfect uses 'had + past participle'. 'Seen' is the past participle of 'see', not 'saw'.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее совершенное время использует 'had + причастие прошедшего времени'. 'Seen' - это причастие от 'see', а не 'saw'.
explanation.uz: Past perfect 'had + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi' ishlatadi. 'Seen' - 'see' so'zining sifatdoshi, 'saw' emas.

options.answer: After he had eaten dinner, he watched TV.
After he has eaten dinner, he watched TV.
After he ate dinner, he had watched TV.

explanation.en: Past perfect 'had eaten' shows the first action was completed before 'watched' (simple past).
explanation.ru: Прошедшее совершенное время 'had eaten' показывает, что первое действие завершилось до 'watched' (простое прошедшее).
explanation.uz: Past perfect 'had eaten' birinchi harakat 'watched'dan (oddiy o'tmish) oldin tugallanganini ko'rsatadi.

options.answer: When I got to the station, the train left.
When I got to the station, the train had left.
When I got to the station, the train has left.

explanation.en: Past perfect 'had left' indicates the train departed before I arrived at the station.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее совершенное время 'had left' указывает, что поезд ушел до того, как я прибыл на станцию.
explanation.uz: 'Had left' poyezd men stansiyaga yetib kelishimdan oldin ketganini bildiradi.

options.answer: She had studied English for five years before she moved to London.

explanation.ru: Прошедшее совершенное время 'had studied' показывает, что период изучения был завершен до переезда в Лондон.
explanation.uz: 'Had studied' o'qish davri Londonga ko'chishdan oldin tugallanganini ko'rsatadi.

options.answer: By the time we arrived, they have started the meeting.

explanation.ru: 'By the time' с прошедшим совершенным временем 'had started' показывает, что встреча началась до нашего прибытия.
explanation.uz: 'By the time' bilan past perfect 'had started' yig'ilish bizning kelishimizdan oldin boshlanganini ko'rsatadi.

options.answer: He had already gone to bed when his friends called.

explanation.ru: Прошедшее совершенное время 'had gone' указывает, что он уже лег спать до того, как позвонили друзья.
explanation.uz: 'Had gone' do'stlari qo'ng'iroq qilishdan oldin u allaqachon uxlashga ketganini bildiradi.

options.answer: I had never been to Paris before that trip.

explanation.en: Past perfect 'had never been' expresses no previous experience before a specific past time.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее совершенное время 'had never been' выражает отсутствие предыдущего опыта до определенного момента в прошлом.
explanation.uz: 'Had never been' ma'lum o'tmish vaqtgacha avvalgi tajriba yo'qligini ifodalaydi.
